judge.rationale: Agreement is limited: pairwise subsets recur around RB/E2F, CDK components, CDKN1B, CDKN1A, FOXM1, and several proliferation markers, but the primary explanations rely on largely distinct ER/MYC, hypoxia/HIF1A, or TGF-β/SMAD contributors, so more than half of the complete molecular content differs and the shared-minority ceiling of 4 applies.
